about: Modwerk source-only loop-fade package for Digitakt I OS 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/loop-fade.

mods.title: Loop & Fade
mods.summary: A live looper on one track that keeps playing through pattern changes, and a crossfader between two groups of tracks and inputs.
mods.description: A live looper on one track that keeps playing through pattern changes, and a crossfader between two groups of tracks and inputs.
mods.author: draadpiraat
mods.on_unit: The author reports this build tested on a Digitakt I, OS 1.54, alone with Core 2.1 and Machine Pages, for over two hours (2026-11-10).
